summary: Returns a 16-bit stack value v1 masked with 0x300, extracting bits 8 and 9. The decompiled source reads v1 before any assignment, so its origin is not evidenced; callers are physics/tire initialization code.

operations.description: Bitwise AND of 16-bit stack local v1 with 0x300, keeping bits 8 and 9

unresolved: v1 is read uninitialized in the decompiled source; likely an FPU control-word read by the caller, but no packet evidence grounds that.
Semantics of the extracted bits are not established.
